<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A multi-step form header: the steps with the current one marked (aria-current step), and the current step's
  text with back and next buttons. Axes: layout (horizontal, vertical), marker (number, icon), summary (show,
  hide).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Step } from "./steps-list.types";

  export type StepperProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    steps: Step[];
    current?: number;
    stepLabel: string;
    back: string;
    next: string;
    layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
    marker?: "number" | "icon";
    summary?: "show" | "hide";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import IconBadge from "../compose/IconBadge.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    steps,
    current = 2,
    stepLabel,
    back,
    next,
    layout = "horizontal",
    marker = "number",
    summary = "show",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: StepperProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} measure="3xl" landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((steps?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
    <Stack gap="6" align="stretch" data-testid="stepper">
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {tpl(stepLabel, current, (steps?.length ?? 0))}
      </Text>
      <List
        tag="ol"
        class={cn(
          "m-0 flex list-none gap-4 p-0",
          (((layout as string) === "vertical") ? "flex-col" : "flex-col sm:flex-row")
        )}
        data-testid="items"
      >
        {#each steps as s, i (s.id)}
          <ListItem
            class="flex flex-1 items-center gap-4"
            data-testid="item"
            aria-current={(((i + 1) === current) ? "step" : undefined)}
          >
            <IconBadge
              variant={(((i + 1) < (current + 1)) ? "primary" : "outline")}
              size="sm"
              class={(((i + 1) < (current + 1)) ? "text-sm" : "text-sm text-muted-foreground")}
            >
              {#if ((marker as string) === "icon")}
                <LucideIcon name={s.icon} size={16} />
              {:else}
                <Inline class="text-sm font-bold">
                  {((i + 1) == null ? undefined : String((i + 1)))}
                </Inline>
              {/if}
            </IconBadge>
            <Text size="sm" weight={(((i + 1) === current) ? "bold" : "semibold")}>
              {s.title}
            </Text>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
      {#if ((summary as string) === "show")}
        {#each steps as s, i (s.id)}
          {#if ((i + 1) === current)}
            <Stack gap="2" class="rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border" data-testid="step-summary">
              <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
                {s.title}
              </Title>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {s.text}
              </Text>
              <Group gap="2" class="pt-2">
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" type="button">
                  {back}
                </Button>
                <Button variant="default" size="sm" type="button">
                  {next}
                </Button>
              </Group>
            </Stack>
          {/if}
        {/each}
      {/if}
    </Stack>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
